anthropic.official_marketplace_route: Ask Anthropic partner contact; separate from directory portal

openai.reason: Core workflow requires the running local desktop and its separately configured MCP server; package shape alone does not establish skills-only eligibility.

data_handling_drafts.reads_personal_data: The instruction package reads no data itself. When connected, measurements, signal labels and local paths returned to the agent can contain personal data.
data_handling_drafts.stores_personal_data: The plugin retains no runtime data. Conversation history, local desktop files and support correspondence have separate retention controls.
data_handling_drafts.other_data_recipients: Tool outputs are available to the configured agent client and model provider. The plugin adds no publisher telemetry or outbound service. GitHub handles distribution and public issues.
data_handling_drafts.retention: No runtime retention by the plugin; client history follows provider settings, desktop artifacts remain until removed under local configuration.

portal_attestations.instructions: Publisher completes account-specific compliance attestations in the portal after reviewing the current terms.
